tagline: flip your site's dark mode, viewport, locale and location from inside the page. no code changes.
hero_hint: the panel on the right edge of this page is the real thing. press d.
how_css: rewrites your own @media rules through the cssom, so prefers-color-scheme, reduced motion, contrast and width breakpoints flip without touching your css.
how_js: patches matchmedia, innerwidth, navigator.language, geolocation and intl.datetimeformat, so your javascript sees the same world your css does.
how_setup: one script tag, or one react element. nothing to configure, nothing shipped to production when you gate it.
knob_scheme_detail: system, light, dark. media rules + matchmedia + color-scheme for light-dark().
knob_locale_detail: en, en-us, tr, de, fr, es, ar, he, ja, zh-cn. html lang, navigator.language, direction from the language or forced ltr/rtl.
knob_geo_detail: antalya, istanbul, berlin, london, new york, san francisco, tokyo, sydney, sao paulo, or custom lat/lng/timezone. geolocation + intl.datetimeformat + getTimezoneOffset.
knob_width_detail: full, 1024, 768, 390. rewrites min-width, max-width and range queries, patches innerwidth, fires resize.
knob_outlines_detail: draw a box around every element.
knob_replay_detail: restart every css animation on the page.
usage_react_note: in next.js app router, load it through next/dynamic so it drops out of production bundles.
limits_body: container queries, vw units, forced-colors, print, pointer type and network cannot be faked from inside a page. use devtools for those. cross-origin stylesheets keep their real media behaviour.
